## CEO overview

What is changing: Firstmate will stop telling the captain that a secondmate is stuck when its only overdue items are scheduled reminders for work that is deliberately waiting on something outside the system.
Why it matters: A secondmate that is busy validating other work cannot clear those reminders, so they pile up and Firstmate repeats the same false alarm even though nothing is actually stuck.
Customer or business impact: The captain sees fewer false alerts, and genuinely stuck work or a question waiting on the captain still raises one.
Risk and rollout: Low.
  Only the exact reminder for a declared outside wait is treated as parked, every reminder stays stored for the secondmate, and the parent keeps observing the secondmate's records without changing them.
  Synchronize this narrative into the live pull request description while preserving its machine-owned `## Pipeline` section, then merge only after every hosted check passes under the standing authorization.

## What changed technically

- Changed the parent watcher to select the oldest valid non-parked row from each local secondmate wake queue instead of treating every valid row as proof of a stalled wake loop.
- Limited parked classification to the existing durable message for a declared external-wait pause recheck.
- Kept genuine wedge rows and captain-held decision rows eligible even when parked reminders appear before them.
- Added executable regression coverage for four accumulated parked reminders, a genuine wedge behind them, a captain-held decision behind them, and byte-for-byte preservation of the foreign queue.
- Documented the non-parked queue boundary and its setting.
- Added `.github/pr-bodies/28.md` as this pull request's tracked description, because the live description still carries the legacy generated narrative that both communication checks reject.

## Module-boundary decision

Module-boundary decision: Current module retained.
  Parked-row filtering belongs in the parent observer in `bin/fm-watch.sh`, where wake-loop stall eligibility is decided, rather than in the secondmate producer or the queue consumer that must retain and eventually handle the reminder.
  This keeps the change separate from dead-worker pause supervision and preserves the foreign queue's existing read-only ownership boundary.

## Decision needed

Decision needed: No decision required.
  The requested safety boundary is covered, and the outer no-mistakes run can merge under the standing authorization once the live description carries this narrative and the final head is green.
